name: Sam Sharp
source:
Sam is both [url=https://vndb.org/c151353]Luna[/url]'s girlfriend AND one of her bandmates at the Moon Goats.

I don't know much about her, just that she makes Luna really happy, and that's enough for me. Damn, Luna is a lucky girl to have such a nice and cute girlfriend. 

It is true that when both are together, they like to mess with me, and she always musses my hair.

[In game description]
